source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Ιωάννης ο Ψυχαΐτης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The epithet is what tells him from every other John**, and the page's couplet makes it a play on the word: bearing the relation of the soul alone, father, you are justly called Psychaites — «Ψυχῆς μόνης σὺ τὴν σχέσιν φέρων Πάτερ, / Ψυχαΐτης κέκλησαι ἐνδίκως μάκαρ». The page does not say what the Psycha was, so nothing is claimed about a monastery of that name. **`confessor` is in `types` because the page says the iconoclast emperors persecuted him and he came back from each persecution**, not because it uses the word. **No year and no place**: the page dates him only by «τα χρόνια της σκληρής πάλης για τις άγιες εικόνες», the years of the hard struggle for the holy icons, which is a period and not a date, so `dates` is absent. It is also the same page that gives him no country, no monastery, no relics and no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
